controls.label: Shape
controls.description: The shared grid marks unavailable surface imagery over the final Didymos v003 stereophotoclinometry shape. Image-resolved regions contain greater detail; smoothly modeled regions lack image coverage. The source estimates approximately 14 m uncertainty in each Cartesian axis and 3.3% in volume. This is a shape model, not a photograph or an albedo map.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows radius in the published Didymos shape minus a 365 m reference sphere. It includes the equatorial ridge and overall flattened shape; it is not height above a gravitational equipotential. Smooth regions are less constrained by images. Cartographic relief and optional Sun lighting are display treatments.

controls.label: Relative albedo
controls.description: Grayscale shows the relative albedo solved with the final DART stereophotoclinometry shape. Values are relative brightness, not absolute geometric albedo or natural color. The gray grid marks facets without a multi-image uncertainty estimate; accepted source facets cover about 58% of the model area. This is a derived surface model, not a photograph.
